videos.title: Hell's Belles
videos.overview: Millie spends a day in Imp City with her sister Sallie May, and the two talk about how their jobs have shaped them.

videos.title: Mission: Antarctica
videos.overview: A simple job in Antarctica turns into an escape from a flock of flesh-eating penguins.

videos.title: Mission: Weeaboo-Boo
videos.overview: Blitzo kills a young woman who is fond of demons, only to have her turn up in Hell and vow to stay by his side.

videos.title: Mission: Chupacabras
videos.overview: Blitzo is captured by a goat farmer who takes him for a Chupacabra and has to improvise a way out as agents close in.

videos.title: Mission: Orphan Time
videos.overview: Blitzo and Loona are sent to kill a children's entertainer but let him say goodbye to his kids first.

videos.title: Mission: Bad Drivezo
videos.overview: After a job, Blitzo gets so angry at a reckless driver that he chases him down.

videos.title: Mission: Whacked Off
videos.overview: While Blitzo and Millie go fishing, Moxxie is sent to kill a mobster's son and ends up sympathising with his target.

videos.title: Mission: Big Boss
videos.overview: Annoyed by his team's pushback, Blitzo kills a CEO and takes over his identity to enjoy a secretary who agrees with everything.

videos.title: Mission: Bigfoot
videos.overview: I.M.P. is hired to hunt Bigfoot without realising he is helping them.

videos.title: Mission: It's Chaz Funeral
videos.overview: Blitzo, Moxxie and Millie are invited to Chaz's "funeral".

videos.title: Barbie's Bad Day
videos.overview: Barbie loses her job after the events of "Unhappy Campers" and struggles to get home to her girlfriend.

videos.title: IMP Training Video
videos.overview: Blitzo tries to film a staff training video, but nobody sticks to his terrible script.

videos.title: Mission: Book Report
videos.overview: Moxxie helps Stolas turn Blitzo's awful drawings of a mission into a proper report.
